purpose: Tailored operational policy for excitation-event analysis

primary_detector.role: conservative baseline and primary event boundaries

secondary_evidence.role: independent onset evidence for long or uncertain primary events; never blind union

candidate_generator.role: candidate note/event proposals and pitch context; not final boundaries

include: usable glissando events with articulation label

evidence_limits.note: These rates are conditional on their samples and are not general corpus accuracy estimates.
